business_problem: Hegui Technology's multi-tenant SaaS operations faced fragmented logs, metrics, and traces across technology stacks, growing alert volumes that required noise reduction and prioritization, and inspections and root-cause diagnosis that depended on senior engineers' experience. The company sought to detect risks proactively and automate cross-system diagnosis.
solution_summary: Hegui Technology's multi-tenant SaaS operations rely on Cloud Monitor 2.0 to collect and standardize logs, metrics, and traces from Alibaba Cloud products, microservices, and cloud resources, giving operators a shared view of end-to-end commerce and membership flows. STAROps adds AI-assisted operations: hourly inspection jobs on core paths detect potential anomalies, perform root-cause analysis, and generate reports for targeted remediation. When alerts trigger, STAROps summarizes events, identifies noise, helps optimize alert rules, and associates alerts with AI diagnosis so on-call staff can locate key issues and receive actionable guidance in the same operational workflow. Hegui codifies senior engineers' inspection and diagnosis procedures as STAROps digital-employee rules and long-running tasks, supporting consistent response and reuse of expertise. No data store, underlying model, or external API is named.
